acceptance.criterion: Resource exhaustion, cancellation and runner crash leave a terminal job result and reclaim processes/storage.
acceptance.status: PASS for dev-mode quota/cancel/crash/startup-reclaim; POSITIVE kernel cgroup enforcement BLOCKED in this environment
acceptance.detail: Real artifact and workspace quota overruns became failed terminal jobs with bounded stderr notes. Cancellation and SIGKILL of the service both ended in terminal rows; setsid/double-fork descendants were checked gone, transient workspace copies reclaimed. Startup recovery marks running jobs failed only after proving the process tree is gone; stale cgroup cleanup failure returns an error and aborts startup. Launch-failure cleanup removes partial workspace and artifact/pool directories (focused regression in pool test). Cgroup mode requires a validated tmpfs export pool and fails closed without one.

acceptance.detail: Owner/claim-scoped logs and artifacts; openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH|NO_SYMLINKS|NO_MAGICLINKS rejected traversal/symlink; 16 MiB file bounds with explicit truncation flags; live logs allowed, artifacts terminal-only; cleanup removes retained export and is idempotent; non-owner/wrong claim gets 404/409. Re-claim advanced attempt 1->2 and lease_generation 1->2, created a new job id, old claim got 409, new claim could not read old job (404), old terminal row retained as fenced audit; retention 0 sweep removed roots while rows survived.
